body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs` contains 42 `try/finally` blocks and a `doctorWith` helper that manually cleans up tempdirs via `d.cleanup()`. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit` in #1098, `doctor.test.mjs` can adopt `tmp(t)` with automatic `t.after` lifecycle cleanup.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update `doctorWith(t, pointer, options)` to take `t` as first argument, create `root` via `tmp(t, 'adlc-doctor-pointer-')`, and remove the `cleanup` callback property.
   - Update test cases calling `doctorWith` to pass `t` and eliminate `try { ... } finally { d.cleanup(); }` blocks.
   - Update standalone test cases using `mkdtempSync` to accept `t`, use `tmp(t, 'adlc-tickets-doctor-')`, and eliminate `try { ... } finally { rmSync(root, ...); }` blocks.
2. Ensure all tickets tests pass: `npm test -w packages/tickets`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs` reports 0 (down from 42).
- AC2 `grep -c 'cleanup' packages/tickets/test/doctor.test.mjs` reports 0.
- AC3 `npm test -w packages/tickets` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC4 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(tickets): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 42 try/finally blocks in doctor.test.mjs
